rationale: Primary QUBO remains unconstructed: rank conversion, coefficient construction and penalty bounds are explicitly unresolved. Separately, the Grover applicability paragraph gives no-smaller-than-every-competitor and earlier-index-on-equality conditions with an explicit finite-column admission. Bind this secondary predicate only, retaining >= and literal not-< readings; competitors exclude the candidate itself. The finite guard applies explicitly to this secondary claim and outside-encoding states are declared classical. Finite agreement would not validate the primary QUBO or execute fallback.

interpretations.meaning: On finite active values, >= every other candidate and precede each equal competitor.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] >= values[j] for j in indices if j != i) and all(i < j for j in indices if j != i and values[i] == values[j])

interpretations.meaning: On finite active values, not-< every other candidate and precede each equal competitor.
interpretations.expression: not any(values[i] < values[j] for j in indices if j != i) and all(i < j for j in indices if j != i and values[i] == values[j])
